title: FairDeDup: Detecting and Mitigating Vision-Language Fairness Disparities in Semantic Dataset Deduplication
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking and mitigating social biases in Vision-Language Pretrained models, specifically targeting demographic attributes such as gender, race, age, and skin tone. While it mentions religion and ethics in passing as a legal basis for identifying sensitive concepts, it does not actually evaluate or benchmark those specific domains.
